plugins.name: mbb-decks
plugins.description: Generate consulting-grade slide decks with Claude. Encodes the MBB house-style rules: action-title storyline, six-section structure, MECE bullets, chart-plus-commentary panels, company logos as bullet markers, citation discipline, and a navy-and-white editorial visual system. Renders to real .pptx files via python-pptx.
